study: KRX Pattern B DEEP exit simple backtest V01

control_artifact.control_reconciliation: version-controlled V01 ledger retained verbatim; row counts, status counts, source hash, and gross summary metrics verified

entry_rule: unchanged adjacent month previous non-DEPRESSED to current DEPRESSED
exit_rule: first observed NORMAL or DEEP_DEPRESSED while held; execute at first exact supported adjusted Open afterward; first trigger remains pending until fill

cost_contract.net_metric_scope: closed trades with a documented exit-date market sell-tax schedule

verdict_rule.improved: closed -30/-50 and open exact-mark -30/-50 rates all strictly lower; realized median, win rate, and +50% rate no lower; matched paired improvements exceed worsened outcomes
verdict_rule.no_benefit: the improved risk condition fails, realized median or win rate or +50% rate is lower, and matched paired improvements do not exceed worsened outcomes
verdict_rule.open_tail_denominator: positions with an exact adjusted close on the evaluation cutoff

annual_and_pairing_definitions.primary_pairing: same ticker+ISU+entry_signal_date; both CONTROL and TEST realized; test exit reason DEEP_DEPRESSED_STOP
annual_and_pairing_definitions.loss_rescued_threshold: CONTROL gross return <= -30/-50 and TEST deep-exit gross return > same threshold
annual_and_pairing_definitions.winner_damage: CONTROL realized gross > 0 and TEST deep-exit gross is lower; +20/+50/+100 tier damage listed separately
annual_and_pairing_definitions.open_control_marks: shown in paired comparison as cutoff marks; excluded from primary final-outcome rescue/winner counts
